newsitem.title: FRANCE: French panel approves Thomson-CSF sale terms.
newsitem.headline: French panel approves Thomson-CSF sale terms.

text.p: The French defence ministry said on Tuesday the independent privatisation commission has approved the government's terms and conditions for the sale of defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF.
State-owned aircraft-maker Aerospatiale could not bid for Thomson-CSF, either on its own or as part of a group offer, the ministry said in a statement.

But because of the close ties Aerospatiale has with Thomson-CSF in a number of areas, Aerospatiale is directly affected by the industrial restructuring which will come out of the privatisation, the statement said.
The government would study with the closest attention proposals made by the bidders for Thomson-CSF and will welcome the recommendations of the Aerospatiale chairman, it added.
The terms and conditions were not disclosed.

The finance ministry earlier said it would publish on Wednesday the terms for tendering for Thomson-CSF, that bids would have to be in by March 28, and it would choose the successful candidate by June 30.
